title: Elisha
hook: When Elijah's mantle fell from the sky and landed at Elisha's feet, fifty prophets stood watching from a distance—close enough to witness the miraculous, but not close enough to participate in it. That distance marks the difference between those who observe God's power and those who wield it, between religious spectators and covenant heirs. What follows in Elisha's ministry is a stunning cascade of miracles that reveal something unexpected: divine power doesn't descend only in wind and fire on mountaintops, but just as often in back rooms where widows face creditors, in rivers where proud generals must humble themselves, and in famine-starved cities where four desperate lepers stumble into deliverance meant for thousands. Elisha's story asks a question that pierces through millennia: Are you standing at a safe distance from God's work, or are you willing to take up the mantle?
